name: @taowind/visual-state-runtime
description: Reality-native visual runtime with full glTF PBR texture channels, bilinear sampling, tangent-space normal mapping, alpha masking, deterministic 3D projection and authority-preserving temporal correction.

scripts.test: npm run build && node dist/tests/run.js && node dist/tests/spatial-reality-3d.js && node dist/tests/gltf-asset.js && node dist/tests/temporal-presentation.js
scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/packages/cli/src/cli.js render-frame examples/hello-title.vsr.json --time 1.5 --out outputs/hello-title.png
scripts.verify: npm run build && node dist/packages/cli/src/cli.js verify examples/hello-title.vsr.json
scripts.studio: npm run build && node dist/packages/cli/src/cli.js serve examples/hello-title.vsr.json --port 4173
scripts.release:audit:v02: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && node scripts/release-audit-v02.mjs
scripts.release:audit:v03: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run test:e2e && npm run evidence:v03 && node scripts/release-audit-v03.mjs
scripts.demo:spatial-3d: npm run build && node dist/packages/spatial-reality-3d-cli/src/cli.js demo outputs/spatial-reality-v04
scripts.verify:spatial-3d: npm run build && node dist/packages/spatial-reality-3d-cli/src/cli.js verify outputs/spatial-reality-v04-verify
scripts.release:audit:v04: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run test:e2e && npm run benchmark:spatial-3d && npm run verify:spatial-3d && node scripts/release-audit-v04.mjs
scripts.release:audit:v05: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:e2e && npm run verify:spatial-3d && npm run benchmark:spatial-3d && node scripts/release-audit-v05.mjs
